To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

herbs and botanicals are able to positively affect growth performance of pigs and broilers, to reduce the risk of infections, to improve feed conversion, to reduce the number of dead piglets, to increase the quality of the meat, to reduce oxidative stress in pigs and to reduce the number and the severity of diarrhea episodes in calves.

herbs and spices are used as feed additives for monogastric animals in the following areas: (1) protection of animals and products against oxidation, (2) stimulation of feed intake, (3) stimulation of endogenous secretions and (4) protection against pathogenic microorganisms, parasites and coccidia.
herbs and botanicals are a valuable feed additive for monogastric animals, but that their use is limited by their high price and the lack of knowledge about their mode of action.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects of herbs: - the identification of active principles - the evaluation of the activity of herbs in monogastric animals - the optimization of the application of herbs in animal nutrition.
